mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys71_security_audit_log ( event_type, result, user_id, target_id, detail, client_ip, user_agent, trace_id ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{result}, #{userId}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{traceId} )
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id, event_type, result, user_id, target_id, detail, client_ip, user_agent, trace_id, created_at FROM sys71_security_audit_log ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
